purpose: Exploratory feasibility research, not a trading system or a claim of live profitability

closing_momentum.observation: Last completed hourly bar, ending 15:30 America/New_York, relative to previous regular-session close
closing_momentum.entry: Next bar open at 15:30; acknowledge boundary execution and closing auction assumptions
closing_momentum.exit: 16:00 close or 1% adverse move in the purchased leveraged ETF, whichever first

opening_breakout.universe: Fixed contemporary sample in groups.json, selection and survivorship limitations disclosed
opening_breakout.entry: Stop entry at opening high plus $0.01, only before 11:00; gap-aware fill
opening_breakout.exit: Entry minus 0.1 prior-14-day ATR, or 15:55 open; no profit target
opening_breakout.same_bar_entry_stop: Pessimistically stopped whenever both touched, unless invalid/incomplete data

original_peer_rebound.status: Coarse five-minute event study; cannot reproduce three-minute stabilization or news exclusions
original_peer_rebound.formation: At least 70% peers down 0.3% or more collectively over 15 minutes; next 10 minutes peer median recovers at least half loss and stock remains behind
original_peer_rebound.entry: After stock posts a positive five-minute bar, next bar open

general.signal_inputs: Only completed bars; rolling estimates exclude current day
general.universe_changes: No changes based on return results
general.no_optimization: All listed variants reported, including failures
general.statistics: Day-level block bootstrap and chronological splits; never treat all same-day stock trades as independent
general.data_limits: Public OHLCV bars are not historical NBBO quotes or executable broker fills
